source_members.clause: Enumerate every pre-existing CLI/domain/alias/feature flag/secret namespace/config key/docs entry/planned feature/HSM-storage adapter/automation caller and confirm Nix packaging, pinned toolchain, concurrency and deployments from a pinned commit.

why_no_existing_packet_owns_it: TRACE-01 validates canonical inventory/mapping/evidence links, TRACE-02 freezes CLI/profile goldens, ARCH-07 wires command features, ARCH-10 measures selected profile closure, OPS-08 validates synthetic outputs, and SEED-50 concerns authorized credential inventory/migration. None accepts the exhaustive current-repository/config/deployment/automation census in §1 line 69. `evidence/census.md` is explicitly a bounded V1 census, not that exhaustive deliverable. The domain starter #9156 is not a granular implementation packet.

source_members.clause: One high-level Rust API achieves the same functionality with paths, byte buffers, secret refs, key handles and stream interfaces; fine-grained APIs support custom pipelines (NATS→DB+Redis) without disk.

A FleetContext builder composes policy, secret stores, signers, event sink and output sink for high-level PKI, generation and reconciliation calls; Rust API semantics equal CLI without spawning Fleet.

why_no_existing_packet_owns_it: These packets own specific seams: ARCH-01 runtime refs, ARCH-06 signer/output authority, GEN-01 generation, CERT-01 PKI, SEC-02/03 records/providers, REC-07 reconciliation, OPS-01/03 plan/apply. None accepts the cross-domain FleetContext composition or proves end-to-end human/script/embedded parity across those operation families. A design can depend on these owners but must not claim their names compose a complete facade.

source_members.clause: Local directory, compressed bundle, secret-store references, default inventory lookup, explicit archives and safe untrusted input are supported uniformly through one resolver.

Commands accepting root/issuer/bundle accept file/directory/archive/stdin and explicit secret reference; named default inventory is restricted to non-root signing; ambiguous sources fail rather than guess.
No silent guessing between ambiguous matching paths, archives and names.
Multiple source candidates must be uniquely identified or disambiguated by a typed selector.
Support an in-memory object for library callers.

why_no_existing_packet_owns_it: ARCH-01 owns the typed secret-reference/runtime resolver seam only; SEC-02/03 own record/provider refs; OPS-04 owns safe filesystem/archive writes; OPS-02 batch DAG validation is not a general input resolver; GEN-01 materializes generated artifacts; CERT-07 handles PKI leaf requests; CERT-12 formats delivery kits; SEED-29 handles manifest-driven portable public-bundle inspect/diff/extract. None accepts one API that resolves all source kinds (including directories, archive/stdin, provider refs, PKI fingerprints, default inventory, hardware handles and in-memory objects) with a single typed ambiguity policy. Supporting proposals cover components, not the resolver contract.
